title: A builder resolves a merge that conflicts in a test file, and a check proves no test was lost
why: Lane doing-needs-live-lane (#1340, F3) merged main and hit conflicts in test and product files. A builder may not commit a merge that touches a test file, and a test-author may not commit product files, so no role could land it; the lane orchestrator committed it itself (head 36c08a00e). Source: coordinator 17:50 CST Nov 6.
note: Ruling R31 (owner 11:02 CST Nov 11, box answer under plan item 3.8: "as long as it's well defined and doesn't create loop holes builder plus check definitely seems ideal no?"; retrospective relay 11:04 CST, plan b5f2551). Changes page items 420 a and 437 a in decision builders-cannot-edit-tests. The check reads test files with the language's parser and refuses at the merge commit: (1) a test case from either parent missing, renamed or moved; (2) a case body that differs from both parents; (3) a skip or expected-fail mark, or a changed assertion, that neither parent had; (4) new test content neither parent had (stays test-author work); (5) a test-config or mutation-test change beyond one parent's version. Each case is shown red before the route opens; the builder-test refusal stays until then. A guard change: rounds and net value apply. Earlier incident (Nov 7 12:30-13:05 CST, lane cs-revive-ready): no single role could commit a merge whose conflicts span test and product files (#1143, #1175, #1179, #1166, #1317). Stage 3, item 3.8.
source: owner 2026-11-11 11:02 CST, relayed by the retrospective session
